agent_explanation: Body moves horizontally into a thin vertical wall while its centre (y~2.06) is below the wall bottom (y=2.9), i.e. grazing the bottom-left corner. The engine lets the overlap grow from -0.09 (step 16) to -0.222 (step 17) with vx pinned at 8.218 (same as initial), so neither impulse nor positional correction pushes it back in x. Lowering the wall so the same body hits the flat side produces a normal bounce, pointing to missing mishandled corner-region wall contact, not thickness or speed alone.
